widgets_values:
**🎤💫 Welcome to the Friendly 🎶 InfiniteTalk Pure! This workflow is configured to generate a single voice and lipsync.**
-

**🔸 The workflow based on new native ComfyUI InfiniteTalk nodes**

**🔸 This setup accelerated and optimized using MultiGPU and new Kijai Chunk FeedForward node for maximum perfomance on LowVRAM systems**

**🔸 For the best perfomance and memory management is recommended to use --reserve-vram ComfyUI parameter in run_nvidia_gpu.bat: --reserve-vram 4 (or larger number in GB if you have any slowdown)**

**🔸 System Requirements by default for 540p:**
- RTX 3000-s, 8GB+ VRAM, 45GB+ RAM, 8-core processor, SSD

**❯❯❯❯ Step-by-Step Generation Control**
-
**For control and convenience, this workflow uses a step-by-step generation control with a fixed seed (manual random seed): Voice Generation and Video Generation**
- **Once you set image and audio crop, move on and enable video generation on step 2**
- **If you need to set a new crop after completing all steps, it's important to disable Video Generation toggle first**

**🗣️ Uploading Image & Audio**
-

**🔸 Audio Sample and Crop**
- Load your audio and crop it to length you need
- Just push Run button to crop. But be sure that video generation toggle is off
- Total video generation length = audio crop duration

🔸 **Noise cancellation**
- Allows you to separate vocals from the music, or speech from the surrounding environment. If you need to use the original track without noise reduction, disable noise cancellation. Noise cancellation can be turned on and off after generation, provided you don't change the seed.

nodes.title: Markdown Note ⬆⬇︎
widgets_values:
**🎚️🎬 Important Video Settings**
-
**The generation output duration is equal to the duration of the audio crop at step 1**

**Video preview is stopped to reduce VRAM consumption. You can resume preview by right click on the node**

**Then you set and crop your audio you should switch on Video Generation**

**🔸 Resolution (size - longer side)**
- In this workflow, the resolution is controlled by a single value of the longer side. The aspect ratio is automatically taken from the source image. For example, if the value is 832, then depending on the aspect ratio of the original video, the resolution will be 832 x 480 or 480 x 832

**🔸 Shift**
- The lower the value, the less character movement.
- The higher the value, the more character movement

**🔸 Motion frame**
- The lower the value, the more movement and emotionality in facial expressions.
- For example, with the default value of 9, the character behaves quite emotionally, while with a value of 25, they speak more calmly, without unnecessary movements.
- Values ​​below 9 begin to cause looping.
- Values ​​above 25 begin to cause strong color variations in the generation.
- Low values ​​are suitable for static (sitting/standing) characters. Higher values ​​are suitable for moving characters, as they help avoid artifacts in the background.
- Also, low values ​​are better suited for short generations, and higher values ​​for long ones
- The higher the value, more generation passes and time are needed

**🔸 Steps**
- 4 steps are recommended beacause the model works with distilled lora
- You can set a little bit higher value and set lower distilled lora strength. For example 6-8 steps and 0,8 lora strength

**🔸 Audio Scale**
- Allows you to make the character's facial expressions and movements more emotional. Default value: 1. The higher the value, the more emotionality, but may introduce artifacts

**🔸 Sampler and scheduler**
- Affects both the generation colors and the character's behavior in the frame
- Euler normal seems to be the most balanced.

nodes.title: Markdown Note ⬆⬇︎
widgets_values:
**📓🎚️ Prompt & Generation**
-

**🔸Seed (Video)**
 - By default, a manual random seed is set for generation for better control over changing settings and step-by-step generation
- Pressing the standard "Run" button generates image using the specified seed value
- You can then change the settings, and when you start generation by pressing the "Run" button, the seed will not change. However, you will be able to see changes in the generation based on the changed settings
- If a new variation is needed, click "Manual Random Seed" in the "Seed" node. Generation with the new seed will start automatically

**🔸 Generation Pass Count**
- Shows generation pass count for total generation
- It depends on audio duration that you set in audio crop
- 1 pass = 81 frames = 3,24 sec. (with default motion frame value 9)
- Correct pass count will refresh after the first pass

**🔸 Prompt**
- For lipsync a simple prompt is sufficient. For example: Woman is speaking. But you can also describe the character's actions if needed

nodes.title: Markdown Note ⬆⬇︎
widgets_values:
**🎚️ Interpolation settings**
-

- 2x interpolation fills the gaps between frames, increasing the frame rate in 2 times. The video turns out smoother and more composed
- You can turn on the interpolation after you generate a video without changing video seed, just pressing "Run" button

nodes.title: Prompt
widgets_values: Woman is singing emotionally and dancing to the rhythm of the music near the sea, the wind is blowing her hair
